keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Matched against award descriptions, e.g. software, construction, security, janitorial. Empty = all new awards.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes (optional)
naicsCodes.description: Only awards under these NAICS industry codes, e.g. 541519. Prefixes work (54 = all professional services).

agencies.title: Awarding agencies (optional)
agencies.description: Full top-tier agency names, e.g. Department of Defense, Department of Veterans Affairs. Empty = all agencies.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Awards signed in the last N days.

minAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAmount.description: Skip awards below this value. 0 = no floor.

smallBusinessOnly.title: Small business winners only
smallBusinessOnly.description: Only awards won by registered small businesses. Useful for teaming, subcontracting and SMB-focused sellers.

enrichRecipient.title: Enrich winner profiles
enrichRecipient.description: Per winner: street address, UEI, business-type flags (small business, veteran owned, ...) and lifetime prime award total. Rows without enrichment are billed as cheaper award rows.

maxAwards.title: Max awards per run
maxAwards.description: Cap on award rows returned (largest first). Controls total cost.
